title: Moderate to strong winds with associated rains
summary: A Tropical depression expected to develop over the Coastline of the Gambia that could generate moderate to strong winds associated with rains in a speed range of 35 - 40Km/h. This will cause threat to fishing activity, Sea navigation and infrastructures along the coastal settlements. Fishermen and other users are advised to observed maximum Sea safety regulations administering by Focal Points at Fishing Landing sites across the country.
